culprit_citations.quoted_text: Fenix Intermediate, LLC | 3.4% of Net Assets | Fair Value 27,912,547

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows the extracted position fair value of 1,309,653,222 exactly equals the filing's debt-and-equity schedule total. The filing reports Members' Capital of 815,597 thousand and prints position percentages only to one decimal; for example, 27,912,547 / 815,597,000 = 3.422%, which is correctly disclosed as 3.4%. The aggregate 25% failure therefore reflects an identity check that treats rounded source percentages as exact, not a source-extraction data defect. Residual risk is limited to individual filer-authored rounding inconsistencies that cannot be localized because the bundle supplies no violating row coordinates.
